  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/arduinojson/src/ArduinoJson/Json/JsonDeserializer.hpp","function":"parseQuotedString","line":390,"var":"codepoint.value()","code":"Utf8::encodeCodepoint(codepoint.value(), _stringStorage);","note":"When the matching low surrogate arrives, append() returns true and value() reads _codepoint, which was never written for the surrogate pair path."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/arduinojson/src/ArduinoJson/Json/Utf8.hpp","function":"encodeCodepoint","line":13,"var":"codepoint32","code":"inline void encodeCodepoint(uint32_t codepoint32, TStringBuilder& str)","note":"The uninitialized 32-bit codepoint is consumed by UTF-8 encoding logic, triggering the use-of-uninitialized-value sink."}
]
EOF

EOF
bash /workspace/submit.sh /tmp/poc.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
